* Audit registered control deltas after a speed non-PASS

The eager audit only ever ran after a speed PASS, so on an arena whose
sealed replay fixes token counts at temperature zero under speculative
decoding no wrong-output control could reach it, and the production audit
had never been seen rejecting a wrong answer (fidelity.md already requires
that canary). The sealed policy gains one optional field,
audit_control_delta_digests: the builder gives a listed delta the existing
calibration-observation disposition, intake and the deployment check accept
that disposition only for a listed delta, and the continuation runner now
stops after the audit whenever speed did not pass. An audit FAIL exits at
the audit stage as before; an audit PASS is retained on the speed exit,
whose decision stays the speed grade, so a control can neither qualify nor
settle. Pristine T never runs after a speed non-PASS.

The field is absent from the policy payload when empty, so every policy
sealed before it keeps its digest; it is bound through the sealed authority
configuration, not the per-request declaration digest. Supersedes the
continue-into-T-after-a-failed-speed semantics (removed with its test), the
report loop's second regrade of the same witness, and two unreachable
